name: wippr guard
description: Blocks prompt-injected tool calls before they run and tracks untrusted input.

wipprCommand.description: Executable for wippr (default: wippr on PATH)

wipprArgs.description: Extra leading args, e.g. ["-m", "wippr"] when wipprCommand is python3

gateUrl.description: Use a running `wippr serve` instead of spawning, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000

failClosed.description: Block tool calls when wippr cannot be reached (default true)
